Heated 40' x 200' barn with 23 box stalls and underfloor heating

blurb: Moose Hill Ranch offers horse boarding with box stalls, paddocks, and pastures. They provide riding lessons for all levels in English and Western disciplines. The facility includes indoor and outdoor arenas, a cross country course, and hosts clinics and special events.
extraNote: All invoices must be paid on the first day of each month for the following month’s board · Invoices paid after the 15th of the month subject to $25 late fee · Zero tolerance for non-payment · Fees subject to change with 30 days written notice
